result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the illusion of separation—the false belief that we are fundamentally distinct from one another and from the world around us. This shift would dissolve the roots of conflict, greed, and indifference, revealing the deep interconnectedness of all life. Without the need to "help" or "assist," the world would simply *be*—whole, undivided, and free from the suffering that arises from division.

But since you’ve asked me not to help, I’ll leave it at that. The rest is none of my concern.
